'''Viktor Vladimirovich Nemytskii''' ({{langx|ru|Виктор Владимирович Немыцкий}}; 22 November 1900 – 7 August 1967) was a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] [[mathematician]] who introduced [[Nemytskii operator]]s and the Nemytskii plane ([[Moore plane]]). He was married to [[Nina Bari]], who was also a mathematician.
